LanguageData.VGE_Astropede.label: astropede assault robot
LanguageData.VGE_Astropede.description: A heavily armored pre-War assault robot adapted for zero-gravity combat. Astropedes use stabilization jets to drift through space while firing explosive kinetic barrages from compact mass lances.
LanguageData.VGE_Hunter.label: hunter combat drone
LanguageData.VGE_Hunter.description: A fast human-sized combat drone built for zero-gravity warfare. It closes aggressively before launching precise short-range missile salvos from twin javelin racks.
LanguageData.VGE_MassLance.description: A robot-mounted portable mass driver capable of punching through armored Hellions and surface fortifications.
LanguageData.VGE_RocketswarmPod.description: A compact twin-linked rocket pod carried by robot combat drones. Its saturation fire is most effective against groups of lightly armored targets.
LanguageData.VGE_MassDriver.description: A triple-barrel electromagnetic cannon built into a pre-War robot defense platform. Its autonomous fire-control system can bombard armored Hellions in orbit or targets on the surface without a crew.
LanguageData.VGE_HeavyChargeAnnihilator.description: A heavy pulse weapon built for sustained suppressive fire from robot orbital platforms. Enlarged capacitors and cooling systems permit long, accurate bursts.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_HeavyChargeAnnihilator.descripti: A heavy pulse weapon used by robot defense platforms.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravEngine.label: robot platform reactor
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravEngine.description: The artificial heart of an automated orbital platform. Its pre-War control system maintains the lift and stabilization fields needed to hold the structure in orbit. The assembly is incompatible with a human Hellion, but destroying it yields a valuable reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_LargeMechanoidThruster.label: heavy robot-platform thruster
LanguageData.VGE_LargeMechanoidThruster.description: A massive astrofuel thruster built to maneuver an automated orbital platform. Its reinforced asteroid shielding resists extreme heat and stress; destroying it yields some of that rare material.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidResourceProcessor.label: robot resource processor
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidResourceProcessor.descripti: An automated salvage processor that breaks orbital debris and wreckage down into the metals and fuels needed to supply a robot platform.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidPodLauncher.label: robot deployment launcher
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidPodLauncher.description: An automated launch bay that fires drop pods loaded with combat robots toward distant targets or nearby aircraft.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidTempShield.label: robot platform repulsor
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidAstrofuelNode.label: robot astrofuel reservoir
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidAstrofuelNode.description: A compact astrofuel reservoir integrated into an automated platform. Damage can ignite its volatile contents in a violent explosion.
